items.markdown:
You can upload and read PDFs directly in [ChatGPT](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXthl48znnJfvuaZ_CDW3nV3bDUJHUfJX4N5cn6OISaTjZxZWFw0-RGWAJ4NWzfwpDLjUNw3p0XSvlyRFJSZrf9_KnyYF4oER63jnf3rh2DuurmDYDUsJZhW2Yj5UZJe52C9HK4iw) by clicking the **'+'** button near the chat bar and selecting **'Add photos & files'**.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXthl48znnJfvuaZ_CDW3nV3bDUJHUfJX4N5cn6OISaTjZxZWFw0-RGWAJ4NWzfwpDLjUNw3p0XSvlyRFJSZrf9_KnyYF4oER63jnf3rh2DuurmDYDUsJZhW2Yj5UZJe52C9HK4iw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXX4gHb9BUQ1pH8SA5Lp7Cs_OkBDyCY23K53noKCMwl4DsWhuUoaNHU6bDfNYDfl1Wn5YVQVg2anRRHNN1h7Mz9dQKQ4kKL6Pcqq0foMG1UOkrTGe8r5Uht7y-jWgTkkXhqY7vr)

### How to Upload and Read a PDF in ChatGPT

- **Upload:** Click the **'+'** icon, select **Add photos & files** , and choose your PDF from your computer, Google Drive, or Microsoft OneDrive.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXthl48znnJfvuaZ_CDW3nV3bDUJHUfJX4N5cn6OISaTjZxZWFw0-RGWAJ4NWzfwpDLjUNw3p0XSvlyRFJSZrf9_KnyYF4oER63jnf3rh2DuurmDYDUsJZhW2Yj5UZJe52C9HK4iw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF10Lot2UlSUzqPcfB8Texlx0oXgDVrKClJinOXs87fLSMLjY_CmWPqyG7roo8tVBR-qXWFrJ1fdjdr8KnfrDa9Z4x1prIF3XXzail-jU9B28n0aHVPJy_LcqwKhMS2OvLR92z2H7_dES_T2LuFiBLGo-LjTDfx2CdaC7CEMPfBsYc)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXX4gHb9BUQ1pH8SA5Lp7Cs_OkBDyCY23K53noKCMwl4DsWhuUoaNHU6bDfNYDfl1Wn5YVQVg2anRRHNN1h7Mz9dQKQ4kKL6Pcqq0foMG1UOkrTGe8r5Uht7y-jWgTkkXhqY7vr)
- **Analyze:** Ask ChatGPT to summarize, extract data, rewrite, or answer specific questions about the document.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXvRsppfUT42HBmYuVdZL806eYXIPHlFKdYUqX2Sbn07csd3_TPJ-hMsbEdiAkjDlT_EetlquTN0uyeQwcB7P0xHEDTN8so-o3IzMCxi7vCNGHOMvy2d6SaZ9ZBpP0A8bQ46Wa92x4lGLn)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXthl48znnJfvuaZ_CDW3nV3bDUJHUfJX4N5cn6OISaTjZxZWFw0-RGWAJ4NWzfwpDLjUNw3p0XSvlyRFJSZrf9_KnyYF4oER63jnf3rh2DuurmDYDUsJZhW2Yj5UZJe52C9HK4iw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF10Lot2UlSUzqPcfB8Texlx0oXgDVrKClJinOXs87fLSMLjY_CmWPqyG7roo8tVBR-qXWFrJ1fdjdr8KnfrDa9Z4x1prIF3XXzail-jU9B28n0aHVPJy_LcqwKhMS2OvLR92z2H7_dES_T2LuFiBLGo-LjTDfx2CdaC7CEMPfBsYc)
- **Limits:** The web version generally supports files up to 50MB and around 150 pages, while mobile apps handle up to 100MB–150MB.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF10Lot2UlSUzqPcfB8Texlx0oXgDVrKClJinOXs87fLSMLjY_CmWPqyG7roo8tVBR-qXWFrJ1fdjdr8KnfrDa9Z4x1prIF3XXzail-jU9B28n0aHVPJy_LcqwKhMS2OvLR92z2H7_dES_T2LuFiBLGo-LjTDfx2CdaC7CEMPfBsYc)

### How to Create a PDF Using ChatGPT

- **Generate Content:** Prompt ChatGPT to write the text, structure, or outline you want.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXfntX5-6_3MlvTDseqUXskMxNVFCbVSbgSdZP04kbDtFOxr55dc4fWL2CLNF55rNsqzLmaq9qbh2i0TLUj6w1aFPw8t9XpaTlCh6DOQWnJgAc_F0nyBcD-OZSdPIizvczrWQJ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXme5EztOaca5TQMOPHXFFs6uOLhPJ0gG5PdJk2shAsFv2v8SPX8Qq6ULUz1Se1QftHvZDGE36_i3eBbnDoswOFg0f9n41fTtYQLTJtyciNrX4xFgv40jWQS4dJHUw9v_3_sE3)
- **Export:** Ask ChatGPT to format and export the content as a downloadable PDF file, or use your browser's print function (`Ctrl + P` on Windows or `Cmd + P` on Mac) and select **Save as PDF**.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXJd9llL3MqKbCoBcZ6zwGoh2679Pz_52xVZIhGAroxipyR-tR-EWTYJTUn0hCpywwZt00zl-TapWkXYn-S7bAI61lro-e6yU2YcXN9FoC7xVsEYIelVeRzcNynviUbz6Nb_WG)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXme5EztOaca5TQMOPHXFFs6uOLhPJ0gG5PdJk2shAsFv2v8SPX8Qq6ULUz1Se1QftHvZDGE36_i3eBbnDoswOFg0f9n41fTtYQLTJtyciNrX4xFgv40jWQS4dJHUw9v_3_sE3)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXfntX5-6_3MlvTDseqUXskMxNVFCbVSbgSdZP04kbDtFOxr55dc4fWL2CLNF55rNsqzLmaq9qbh2i0TLUj6w1aFPw8t9XpaTlCh6DOQWnJgAc_F0nyBcD-OZSdPIizvczrWQJ)
